reviews.title: Charged, asked to leave, then unable to cancel
reviews.text:
I joined the available fourth spot in a padel match through Playtomic and was charged. Shortly afterwards, another participant asked me to leave because they already had a fourth player arranged elsewhere.

When I tried to cancel, the app blocked me because the match was less than 24 hours away. So Playtomic accepted my booking and payment, the group asked me to give up my place, and the app provided no way to resolve the situation.

I also received comments about my playing level that I found patronising and unwelcoming. If approval or a particular level is required, those checks should happen BEFORE payment is taken.

For transparency, the other player offered to reimburse me in cash at the club, which I declined. Travelling to collect cash from another player is not an acceptable substitute for a proper refund process through the platform.

This is a serious failure in the booking experience. A place should not be advertised as available if the group considers it reserved for someone else. And a customer asked to leave should have a straightforward route to cancellation and a refund.

Taking payment is easy. Protecting the customer afterwards is the part Playtomic needs to fix. Based on this experience, I cannot recommend its open-match booking system.

reviews.title: Best and worst app
reviews.text:
This app is so good at booking into open matches. 
However the scoring system is flawed, your reliability has too much of a factor, and you don’t get much of a boost for beating better players than you. 
The AI - live chat is HORRIFIC. 2 times I’ve had issues and got no where. I ask for a human and don’t get anywhere. 
This feature where you can turn private matches public needs BIG improvements: 1) I didn’t realise I’m paying for everyone and anyone who joins gets a free / cheap game. Why don’t I get money back??
2) if I’m paying for it, why am I playing against people with scores so much lower than me. If I’m paying why don’t I have control of who I play against. 
I have raised both of these issues (scoring + turning a private matche to public) with the live chat and got no where. Just more frustration and anger. What makes it all worse is that I am an investor in this company.

reviews.title: Very disappointing first experience
reviews.text:
Very disappointing experience, especially as a first-time user.

I booked a private padel game for 4 players, but only 2 of us joined. I assumed the booking would automatically be cancelled if the 4 players weren’t confirmed, as this is how other padel apps work. Unfortunately, Playtomic does not work this way, and I ended up paying £22 for a session we cannot use.

I contacted Playtomic support several times, but they were unable to offer a refund or even Playtomic credit as a goodwill gesture, and simply referred me back to the club’s cancellation policy.

I understand that policies exist, but I think this should be much clearer during the booking process, especially for first-time users. Unfortunately, this experience has made me think twice about using Playtomic again.

reviews.title: Pending on split payment
reviews.text:
My biggest issue with Playtomic is how it handles split payments.

When you split the cost between four players, it places a holding charge on the remaining players’ shares. Even after everyone has paid and the match has been played, that hold can stay on your account for up to a week.

My question is: what’s the point?

It’s incredibly frustrating when I want to book another game but won't because money is still being held from a match that was fully paid for and finished days ago. It makes no sense and really needs fixing.

reviews.title: Why is the filtering so bad? Manual adjust rank at 100 disappeared.
reviews.text:
After 100 games I had the option to manually adjust the my rank. I came back to the app later on in the day to adjust that, and no longer have that option... I would really like to bump my rating, why did I lose that opportunity?

Regarding filtering:

Why am I shown games I don't want to see (e.g. I have only men, mixed, and all players selected: the app shows me women only games in addition - if the answer is because "all players is selected, that is awful coding for AND).

Also WHY cannot I not select Ranked or Friendly only?

Lastly filter for times. I want to be able to select both afternoon and evening...nope! Cannot. But you can select this 8 hour window, that feature does not suit my use case. 

Instead you can filter by worthless attributes like wall, crystal, and panoramic... 

Add more filters please!

This also applies to alerts.
